caveats: Initial and continuing approvals are never added. A continuing approval is the same person renewed; adding them counts one worker once a year for as long as they stay.

Employer names are truncated at about 34 characters in the older files, so one agency can appear several ways. Variants are grouped when one name is a prefix of another, and every raw name as filed is published beside the group.
An agency is identified from the employer name on the form. One that files under a name without its state in it is not counted, so these figures are a floor.
Public universities, counties, cities and school districts are excluded. A public university is a state institution too; it is measured elsewhere on this site.
Sponsoring an H-1B is lawful, and nothing here says otherwise.
